mapper.select: SELECT /*+ INDEX(TS_SMS_2020 IDX_TS_SMS_2020_TEMP_2025_07) */ /* O.dhncorp.findAllBySearchParamForPush_T0507 */ SEQNO, 'AP' AS TYPE, MSG, MSG as MSG_SMS, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TYPE,1,1) = 'P' THEN CASE WHEN LENGTHB(MSG) <= 90 THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END ELSE '' END AS SMSKIND, CASE WHEN DESTNO LIKE '82%' THEN DESTNO WHEN DESTNO LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(DESTNO, 2, 15) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(DESTNO, 2, 15) END AS DESTNO, CALLBACK, BILLID, TITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, KAKAO_CODE, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TYPE,1,1) = 'P' OR SUBSTR(TYPE,1,1) = 'D' THEN #{profile_key} ELSE '' END AS PROFILE_KEY, CASE WHEN REQDTTM IS NULL THEN '00000000000000' ELSE TO_CHAR(REQDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') END AS REQDTTM, PUSH_ID, APP_KEY, APP_SECRET, APP_LINK, ATCH_FILE_SN, APP_LAUNCH FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TYPE = #{group_no}

SELECT /*+ INDEX(TS_SMS_2020 IDX_TS_SMS_2020_TEMP_2025_07) */ /* O.dhncorp.findAllBySearchParamForTalk_T0507 */ SEQNO, 'AT' as TYPE, MSG, MSG as MSG_SMS, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TYPE,1,1) = 'T' THEN '' WHEN SUBSTR(TYPE,1,1) = 'K' THEN CASE WHEN LENGTHB(MSG) <= 90 THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END END AS SMSKIND, CASE WHEN DESTNO LIKE '82%' THEN DESTNO WHEN DESTNO LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(DESTNO, 2, 15) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(DESTNO, 2, 15) END AS DESTNO, CALLBACK, BILLID, TITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, KAKAO_CODE, #{profile_key} AS PROFILE_KEY, CASE WHEN REQDTTM IS NULL THEN '00000000000000' ELSE TO_CHAR(REQDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') END AS REQDTTM FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TYPE = #{group_no}

SELECT /*+ INDEX(TS_SMS_2020 IDX_TS_SMS_2020_TEMP_2025_07) */ /* O.dhncorp.findAllBySearchParamForSMS_T0507 */ SEQNO, 'PH' as TYPE, MSG, MSG as MSG_SMS, CASE WHEN LENGTHB(MSG) <= 90 THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END AS SMSKIND, DESTNO, CALLBACK, BILLID, TITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, CASE WHEN REQDTTM IS NULL THEN '00000000000000' ELSE TO_CHAR(REQDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') END AS REQDTTM FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TYPE = #{group_no}
